use_case_summary: Primary workload: high-sensitivity document search + redaction in customer support and investigations. Must process PII and regulated financial docs. Expect mostly embedding + reranking pipeline with occasional chat assistants. Latency SLOs: 150-300ms p50 generation for short queries; throughput: sustained 200 QPS for embeddings during peak batch jobs. Cost sensitivity moderate; willingness to trade cost for strict residency and auditability.
architecture_fit_notes: Customer requires private VPC deployment with no public ingress. Preferred model: Redwood Private deployed into customer VPC via cross-account role and dedicated subnet. Proposed topology: two private subnets per AZ running inference nodes, management/control plane endpoints accessed via AWS PrivateLink, egress through customer-managed NAT gateway and monitored egress VPC. KMS: BYOK required, cross-account KMS grants with strict key policy. Audit logging: CloudTrail + VPC Flow Logs forwarded to Splunk/Graylog; explicit CloudWatch log retention policy 7 years. Region requirement: primary eu-west-1 for EU resident customers; failover to na-east-1 for DR only if contractual residency allows. Inbound: strictly private endpoints (PrivateLink); no public IPs. Outbound: restricted to allowed destination IP ranges for model updates and licensing; customer firewall requires a list of FQDNs/IPs. SAML SSO via Okta, SCIM user provisioning requested.
poc_scope: 30-day POC: 1) Deploy control plane connectors into a staging VPC, 2) Stand up inference pool in two private subnets (single AZ) with sample model, 3) Demonstrate BYOK KMS integration and cross-account grant, 4) Show audit logs flowing to customer Splunk instance and retention configuration, 5) Run synthetic workload (embeddings 200 QPS) and report latency/cost metrics.
